about: Higgsfield brief for Batalla de Nieve en Ski Dubái (gameType 'snow', docs/specs/batalla-de-nieve.md). Version 1 shipped with canvas-drawn tiles and props (public/js/snow-render.js) + the saga avatars, the cast stickers and the Dubai landmark pieces that already exist. These pictures replace the canvas drawings one by one. Make them with the higgsfield-art skill in his Chrome (Nano Banana Pro, Unlimited ON, 1:1, 2K). Originals -> assets-library/higgsfield/<date>/snow/<world>/<slug>.png; stickers on GREEN are keyed to transparent WebP (video_tools keying, like the cast stickers); web copies -> public/assets/snow/<world>/<slug>.webp (Pillow thumbnail 512 for props, 256 for small pickups, WebP q82). Every prop is seen from the same top-down 3/4 camera (looking down at about 55 degrees, front face visible, light from the top left) so the props sit together on the tile map. Then swap the matching draw* function in snow-render.js for a drawImage of the sticker (keep its footprint in public/js/snow-map.js).
style: Premium glossy 3D animated movie style, cute toy-like objects, rounded shapes, soft pastel colors, soft studio lighting, seen from a top-down three-quarter game camera (about 55 degrees from above). <SUBJECT> Centered, the whole object visible with a little margin. <BG> background. Kid friendly. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no signs with writing, no brand names.
dralingo: Same character as the first reference image: Dralingo, the cute glossy 3D cartoon blue baby dragon with big turquoise eyes, white belly, turquoise head spikes and blue wings with white membranes, dressed like the second reference image: a real Emirati white kandura, a white ghutra headscarf with a black agal, and a neat black curled mustache with a short trimmed black beard. Plain wings with no letters or symbols. Pose: <POSE> Alone, no other characters.
cast: Same character as the reference image: <WHO>. Glossy 3D cartoon render like a premium animated movie. <SCENE> Alone (the only person in the picture), no vehicle.
